question: Q-2's teacher and student, pre-registered and unchanged, on the current default boxes (F-0e bands+strips on pilot-000, F-0c's and F-0f's not-a-book filter on): does the predicted fill now pass Q-2's go rule
inputs: pilot-000 (31 photos): F-0e bands+strips boxes, the readers F-0e ran on them, F-0's decision (F-0c's cached base decisions); yardstick-library B2 (40 Library Dataset images, PROXY): F-0's own B2 run, the default for shelf-scale photos; both after the shipped not-a-book filter (F-0c shape rules, F-0f shelf-label rules); Q-1's features and Q-2's top-seam geometry re-measured on the new pilot-000 boxes
labels: teacher rungs are machine agreement, not accuracy (INV-17); pilot-000 and the yardstick are reported separately, never pooled (OC35); the student is trained on pilot-000 only and scored on the yardstick unchanged (H-0 §4.3)

teacher.tauRule: smallest τ on a 0.01 grid at which at most 1 % of null pairs (reader A on one box, reader B on a different box of the same photo) agree; set on pilot-000 only
teacher.similarity: 1 - (edit distance from the shorter squashed reading to its closest substring of the longer) / its length; readings shorter than 5 normalised characters never agree; best over reader pairs and variants
teacher.floorRule: Q-1's H3 cut (B2 box score), kept: the go-rule result moves little across 0.20-0.30 (sensitivity)
teacher.population: box score >= floor, long axis not horizontal (F-0's reader cannot read lying boxes; Q-1 finding 3), the five student features measurable

student.label: teacher rung >= text-read (1) vs spine-found or text-present (0)
student.folds: pilot-000: leave one photo out (31 fits per model); yardstick: one fit on all of pilot-000, applied unchanged
student.baseline: crop width alone (log short side), direction learned per fold
student.monotone: active-set: a feature whose standardised weight comes out against its declared sign is dropped and the model refit

goRule.rule: student AUC >= 0.75 on pilot-000 (leave-one-image-out), and its gain over the crop-width baseline has a 95 % interval excluding 0

operatingPoint.rule: FILL_P = the lowest score at which at least 90 % of predicted fills are measured >= text-read on pilot-000 (leave-one-image-out); if none does, Q-0's starting value 0.7

fragments.why: the same fragment measures on the current default boxes (F-0e bands+strips on pilot-000), to compare with Q-2's

definitions.cut: F-0's per-box flag: cut by a detector tile edge
definitions.partial: not cut, box long side < 0.55 of its shelf band's height

fragments.features: diag:student+fragment adds cutByTile (-) and heightOverBand (+, capped at 1.5, missing = 1) to the student

ownerHypothesis.ownerSaid: top edges are missed at frame edges and in oblique views where a book's top face shows beside its spine

features.heightOffBand: |log(box long side / median long side of the boxes in its shelf band)|; 0 when the band has fewer than 3 boxes
features.topSeamOff: |offset| of the strongest colour step across the spine near its top (helpers/coverage/geometry.py), as a share of the long side; > 0.05 inside = overshoot, < -0.05 = cut

cells.topInView: top end below 0.6 of the frame height (camera looks down onto the top: a geometric proxy, not a detector)

outlinesForU4.rule: drawn from its outline when at least 50 % of the mask lies inside the box (grown 3 % along, 8 % across) and covers at least 60 % of it
